test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The tenure of the chairman of the IPO-bound Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) has been extended by one more year by the government, till March 2023. Who is the chairman of LIC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangalam Ramasubramanian Kumar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mangalam Ramasubramanian Kumar was appointed as the Chairman of Life Insurance Corporation (LIC) of India, one of India's largest public sector financial institutions.
 
• His term as Chairman, initially set to end in 2022,
 
 
• was extended by the Indian government till March 2023 to provide continuity in leadership, especially as LIC prepared for its initial public offering (IPO), one of the largest in India's financial market history.
 
• Under his leadership, LIC undertook significant preparations for its IPO, focusing on compliance, restructuring, and improving transparency in line with regulatory requirements for a publicly listed company.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tablesh Pandey**

 
 
• Tablesh Pandey is a senior official in LIC and serves as one of its Managing Directors.
 
• Managing Directors in LIC play a key role in decision-making, managing various portfolios, and supporting the Chairman in policy implementation.
 
• Although Tablesh Pandey holds a significant position in LIC, he is not the Chairman.
 
• He assists in managing LIC’s operations, which are vast and complex, given LIC’s status as a public sector insurance giant.
 
 
 
• **Arun Kumar Anand**
 
 
• Arun Kumar Anand is another senior executive in the insurance sector but is not currently associated with LIC in the capacity of either Chairman or Managing Director.
 
• He is not directly relevant to the current question regarding the Chairman of LIC.
 
• This option does not apply to LIC’s leadership structure as of the date mentioned in the question.
 
 
 
• **Raj Kumar**
 
 
• Raj Kumar also served as a Managing Director at LIC. Like other Managing Directors, his responsibilities included overseeing LIC’s diverse functions, ensuring compliance, and supporting corporate strategy. However, he was not the Chairman.
 
• Raj Kumar held a top position at LIC but did not serve as Chairman.
 
• His work contributed to LIC’s functioning but did not directly pertain to the role of Chairman.
